from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "error_code_curr")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["qrcode"] =~ /^${qrcode:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["protectboard_id"] =~ /^${pb_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serialboard_id"] =~ /^${sb_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] =~ /^${rack_id:regex}$/)

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "qrcode"])
  |> group(columns: ["qrcode"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "qrcode"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(
      start: v.timeRangeStart,
      stop: v.timeRangeStop
  )

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "${meas}" and

      (
          r["_field"] == "voltage" or
          r["_field"] == "temperature" or
          r["_field"] == "current" or
          r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_1" or
          r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_2" or
          r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_3" or
          r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_4" or
          r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_5"
      ) and

      r["return_code"] =~ /^${return_code:regex}$/ and
      r["qrcode"] =~ /^${qrcode:regex}$/ and
      r["protectboard_id"] =~ /^${pb_id:regex}$/ and
      r["serialboard_id"] =~ /^${sb_id:regex}$/ and
      r["storehouse_id"] =~ /^${rack_id:regex}$/
  )

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_field"] == "voltage" or
      r["_field"] == "temperature" or
      (
          (
              r["_field"] == "current" or
              r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_1" or
              r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_2" or
              r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_3" or
              r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_4" or
              r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_5"
          ) and
          exists r["position_id"] and
          r["position_id"] == "1"
      )
  )

  |> aggregateWindow(
      every: v.windowPeriod,
      fn: last,
      createEmpty: false
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: float(v: r["_value"]),

      _field:
          if r["_field"] == "voltage" then
              "01_" + r["qrcode"] + "_Volt"

          else if r["_field"] == "temperature" then
              "02_" + r["qrcode"] + "_Temp"

          else if r["_field"] == "current" then
              "03_Current"

          else if r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_1" then
              "04_WireVolt_1"

          else if r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_2" then
              "04_WireVolt_2"

          else if r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_3" then
              "04_WireVolt_3"

          else if r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_4" then
              "04_WireVolt_4"

          else
              "04_WireVolt_5"
  }))

  |> keep(columns: [
      "_time",
      "_field",
      "_value",
      "return_code",
      "storehouse_id",
      "serialboard_id",
      "protectboard_id"
  ])

  |> rename(columns: {
      return_code: "ReturnCode",
      storehouse_id: "StoreHouseID",
      serialboard_id: "SerialBoardID",
      protectboard_id: "ProtectBoardID"
  })

  |> group(columns: [])

  |> pivot(
      rowKey: [
          "_time",
          "ReturnCode",
          "StoreHouseID",
          "SerialBoardID",
          "ProtectBoardID"
      ],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )

  |> sort(
      columns: [
          "_time",
          "SerialBoardID"
      ]
  )

list.label: SelectExportData
list.name: select_export_data
list.query: Voltage : voltage, Temperature : temperature, Current : current, WireVoltage : wire_voltage

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${select_export_data:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["_field"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;
